issues.title: parse_updated crashes on lowercase z timestamps
issues.author: alice-dev
issues.body:
Our upstream feed started sending timestamps with a lowercase `z` suffix, and `parse_updated` rejects them:

```
>>> from toybox.dates import parse_updated
>>> parse_updated('2026-01-02 03:04:05z')
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<stdin>", line 1, in <module>
  File "toybox/dates.py", line 15, in parse_updated
    return datetime.strptime(v, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
ValueError: unconverted data remains: z
```

The uppercase `Z` form works. A trailing `z` means the same thing and should be accepted too.

issues.title: Three date parsers duplicate the same logic
issues.author: bob-maint
issues.body: `parse_created`, `parse_updated` and `parse_deleted` in `toybox/dates.py` each call `datetime.strptime` with the same format string, with small differences in what they strip first. It would be easier to keep them consistent if all three delegated to one shared helper.

issues.title: Sorting is unstable for equal keys
issues.author: carol-qa
issues.body: `sort_items` in `toybox/sorting.py` has a comment saying `reverse=True` flips ties between runs. I think items with the same `ts` can come back in a different order from the one they went in. I haven't written a reproducer yet.

issues.title: How do I change the date format?
issues.author: dave-user
issues.body: Our timestamps look like `02/01/2026 03:04`. Is there a setting to make toybox parse a different date format, or do I have to change the code?

issues.title: parse_updated fails with a trailing lowercase z
issues.author: erin-ci
issues.body: Nightly import failed on `2026-03-04 05:06:07z` with `ValueError: unconverted data remains: z` from `parse_updated`. Looks like only the uppercase `Z` suffix is handled.
